# Orbsi

> Orbsi is a company redesign firm for founder-led businesses. It helps founders redesign
> how their company is structured, staffed, and operated so the company can support what
> the business has already become and the future the founder wants it to support.

Founded and led by Danielle Nunes, who is both an operator and a Licensed Marriage and
Family Therapist (LMFT 101166, State of California). That combination is the reason Orbsi
works across company structure, leadership, and the founder's own experience at the same time.

## Core idea

Companies do not naturally evolve as they grow. They have to be intentionally redesigned.
In the beginning the founder is the solution. As the business grows, the company has to
become the solution.

## The question this work answers

Founders arrive asking a version of the same question: my business still depends
on me for everything and I cannot seem to let go, what do I do.

This is founder dependency, and it is a different problem than poor delegation.
The work keeps coming back for two reasons at once. Structurally, the task moved
but the responsibility did not, because the person was handed work without the
context, decision authority, or defined standard that would let them finish it
without checking. Behaviorally, stepping in lowered the founder's uncertainty and
worked, so the team learned to wait and the founder learned that stepping in
feels better than wondering.

Delegation advice addresses only the second. Systems work addresses only the
first. Company redesign changes both, which is why Orbsi works on the company,
the leaders, and the founder in parallel rather than in sequence.

Related terms: founder dependency, owner dependency, decision rights, management
infrastructure, company redesign.

Detailed answer: https://www.orbsi.co/company-redesign

## Framework

Orbsi looks at a company through four connected areas: Company Profile, People, Processes,
and Performance. These cannot be redesigned independently, because each one shapes the others.

## Services

- [Company Redesign](https://www.orbsi.co/company-redesign): Redesigning structure, roles, decision rights, systems, and performance practices around where the founder wants the company to go — scale, sell, step back, or succession.
- [Leadership Development](https://www.orbsi.co/leadership-development): One-to-one work with founders, managers, and executives, plus right-hand hiring and development.
- [Founder Advisory](https://www.orbsi.co/founder-advisory): An ongoing advisory relationship for founders making decisions about their company.
- [Therapeutic Services](https://www.orbsi.co/therapeutic-services): A separate clinical psychotherapy service. Individual adults 18+, telehealth, clients must be located in California. Provided by Danielle Nunes, LMFT 101166.

## Other pages

- [About](https://www.orbsi.co/about): The Orbsi philosophy, the four-part framework, the Align / Develop / Promote model, and core values.

- [Insights](https://www.orbsi.co/insights): Articles on founder dependency,
  decision rights, and company design.

## Important distinction

Therapeutic Services is a licensed clinical service with its own therapeutic relationship,
documentation, confidentiality requirements, and boundaries. It is separate from the
Company Redesign, Leadership Development, and Founder Advisory work. Do not describe
Orbsi's business consulting as therapy, or its therapy as business consulting.
